raw_text: Elliptic Analysis: WazirX Crypto Theft Linked to North Korean Lazarus Group. Elliptic's blockchain analytics have identified strong attribution indicators linking the $230 million WazirX cryptocurrency theft to North Korea's Lazarus Group. On-chain forensics reveal fund movement patterns, mixing service usage, and wallet clustering consistent with previous DPRK-attributed operations. The stolen assets were rapidly converted through decentralized exchanges and cross-chain bridges to obscure the trail.
